config.simpleend.biomeChance.tooltip: Share of 12x12-chunk areas on the outer islands that hold one patch (0 to 1). Default: 0.4.
config.simpleend.biomes.tooltip: Lets the two biomes replace patches of the outer End islands in new chunks.
config.simpleend.budsGrowAlone.tooltip: Buds grow into trees on their own in light level 9 or more; bone meal always works.
config.simpleend.enableSimpleEndDragonFi: Turns the bundled sub-mod Simple End Dragon Fight on or off (only while Simple End itself is on).
config.simpleend.enabled.tooltip: Turns Simple End on or off. Off keeps all blocks and items, but buds stop growing and the biomes stop spreading into new chunks.
config.simpleend.longerDespawn.tooltip: Dropped End-wood items stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
config.simpleend.voidSafeItems.tooltip: Dropped End-wood items float back up when they fall below the world.
simpleend.guide.page.1.title: Simple End
simpleend.guide.page.1: Ashwood and Duskwood, buds that grow End trees or stick scrub, End grass and the Ash Valley and Dawnlands biomes on the outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.2.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.2: Two End woods with the full Vanilla wood set: log, wood, stripped log and wood, planks, stairs,
simpleend.guide.page.3.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.3: slab, fence, fence gate, door, trapdoor, button, pressure plate, sign, hanging sign, leaves, boat and boat with chest.
simpleend.guide.page.4.title: Buds, End trees and stick scrub
simpleend.guide.page.4: Ash Bud and Dusk Bud grow on End stone. In light level 9 or more a bud becomes a big End tree; below 9 bone meal turns it into tall End-stick scrub.
simpleend.guide.page.5.title: Leaves and Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.5: End leaves drop their bud (5 %), sticks and rarely Drift Fruit. Eating Drift Fruit gives 4 seconds of Slow Falling and a small hop - a short glide.
simpleend.guide.page.6.title: Void-safe wood
simpleend.guide.page.6: Dropped End-wood items (logs, planks, everything of the sets, buds, End grass, Drift Fruit) are not lost in the void:
simpleend.guide.page.7.title: Void-safe wood
simpleend.guide.page.7: below the world they float back up and hover just above the bottom. They also stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
simpleend.guide.page.8.title: End grass and End bushes
simpleend.guide.page.8: Wiry End grass and twiggy End bushes, like Vanilla dry grass and dead bushes, standing on End stone. They grow in Ash Valley and Dawnlands and sparsely on all outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.9.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.9: Two End biomes on the outer islands (never on the dragon island): round patches
simpleend.guide.page.10.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.10: 3-6 chunks across replace parts of the End highlands/midlands. Ash Valley grows Ashwood, Dawnlands Duskwood.
simpleend.guide.page.11.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.11: SimpleBuilding bundles Simple End ("Enable Simple End"); Simple End bundles Simple End Dragon Fight ("Enable Simple End Dragon Fight" in config/simpleend.json). Each level has its own switch;
simpleend.guide.page.12.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.12: Dragon Fight runs only while Simple End is on. Simple End also plays alone.
